_comment: Pre-recorded per-chunk situating context for the contextual-retrieval A/B (Listing 15-3). In production an LLM writes one sentence per chunk after reading the whole document (Anthropic, Introducing Contextual Retrieval, 2024). Here the strings are baked so the A/B is deterministic and runs in CI with no API key. Keyed by 'doc_id::heading'. If a key is missing, contextual.deterministic_context_stub() synthesizes an equivalent from the document title and heading.
